operation_cold_breach.threat_type: Cloud Perimeter Penetration & Host Command Injection
operation_cold_breach.briefing: At 03:00 AM UTC, perimeter intrusion alarms on cloud server node archive-node-09 went dead. The intruder probed administrative directories, bypassed an unhardened IAM policy, initiated a covert encrypted tunnel, and weaponized a utility healthcheck script with command injection. Inspect the evidence, isolate the IP, remediate permissions, decode the tunnel, and patch the zero-day to lock out the adversary.

phantom_cipher.threat_type: Industrial SCADA Traversal & Algorithm Downgrade Attack
phantom_cipher.briefing: At 04:15 AM UTC, industrial telemetry on municipal water pipeline controller scada-plc-04 registered unauthenticated coil override packets. The adversary utilized a rogue industrial gateway, forged an unsigned JWT token, established a legacy weak cipher tunnel, and attempted SQL injection against valve state logs. Your mission: trace the flow log, enforce JWT signature verification, reconstruct modern authenticated encryption, and patch the SQL injection.

black_ice.briefing: At 01:20 AM UTC, data loss prevention sensors detected massive ledger exfiltration from database cluster vault-db-master. The attacker probed payment endpoints using blind time-based SQL injection, abused an unrestricted superuser database role, initiated a covert channel, and deployed an untrusted Python pickle deserialization payload. Isolate the intruder, restrict database roles, harden key custody, and patch the deserialization zero-day.
